name: stable-id-retry
meaning: Retry returns original receipt, no second admission.

name: conflicting-id
meaning: Same request cannot change commitment.

name: retry-after-cut
meaning: Retry after sealing is idempotent.

name: late-admission
meaning: Sealed content does not include later input.

name: next-snapshot
meaning: An admitted ID may legitimately appear once in each later snapshot.

name: membership-is-ordered
meaning: Permutation changes the fixed membership context.

name: new-id-not-deduplicated-by-value
meaning: Equal payload tokens under distinct IDs are different admissions.

name: invalid-request
meaning: Invalid sequence is rejected.

name: activation-replay
meaning: Repeated identical activation is idempotent.

name: activation-immutable
meaning: A second generation cannot replace the active one.

name: duplicate-ready-slot
meaning: Repeated signature identity is not an extra slot.

name: foreign-context
meaning: Activation checks the full sealed context.

name: wrong-share-slot
meaning: Share destination is enforced.

name: immutable-slot-write
meaning: One generation slot cannot change its value.

name: ready-requires-persistence
meaning: A staged but unpersisted value cannot issue READY.

name: crash-discards-volatile
meaning: The crash transition discards staged values.

name: crash-keeps-durable
meaning: Durability here is the model definition, not a hardware measurement.

name: replay-same-generation
meaning: Exact replay preserves the immutable slot.

name: no-cross-generation-fallback
meaning: Missing pinned state is not replaced by a different generation.

name: pin-not-latest
meaning: A newer arrival cannot alter a pinned read.

name: invalid-primitive-negative-control
meaning: A bad private share passes the wrapper when the assumed resharing primitive is violated. This is an intentional limitation, not a security PASS.

name: early-ready-crash-0
meaning: Premature READY allows an activated epoch with missing data after a crash.

name: early-ready-crash-1
meaning: Premature READY allows an activated epoch with missing data after a crash.

name: early-ready-crash-2
meaning: Premature READY allows an activated epoch with missing data after a crash.
